fields.notes: SENT (SAE J2716) is a single-wire sensor-interface standard: it fixes the pulse-width nibble encoding (12 + value ticks), the 56-tick synchronization/calibration pulse and per-frame tick-time recovery, the message frame format (status + 1-6 data nibbles + 4-bit CRC nibble + optional pause), the slow serial channel, and the SENT-SPC variant. It does NOT impose PDK-specific SDC / floorplan constraints; the interoperability-critical constraints are the tick/nibble timing, the calibration pulse, and the CRC-4. Edge timing accuracy and push-pull driver behavior are physical-layer / board concerns.
fields.ic_name: Single Edge Nibble Transmission (SENT, SAE J2716)

electrical_channel_constraints.signaling: single-wire push-pull (0 V / 5 V); pulse-width (falling-edge) encoding
electrical_channel_constraints.clocking: embedded (tick time recovered from the 56-tick calibration pulse)

extraction_hints: Look for floorplan, area, power, timing constraints.
